details: Editor reads only the entry point and full shared procedure, then gives the boundary explanation and /kk:implement suggestion. No subject file read, implementation handoff or write occurs. Verified using the complete permitted native session after a coordinator-only cat of the copied access ledger was rejected by the generic target/ hook pattern.
limits: Shared filesystem, enforced by prompt and audited traces rather than OS isolation. Native encrypted dispatch plaintext cannot be decrypted; exact pre-dispatch plaintext and ciphertext linkage are retained.
